Appearance.pluginStylingDescription: These plugins are applying their own styles to your site, combined with the colors you set here: {{plugins}}. Your settings are applied on top, so they win where they overlap. Autoplay.description: Choose whether the stream starts playing on its own when a viewer opens your page.
Autoplay.optionAlwaysDescription: The stream always starts on its own the moment someone opens the page. It plays with sound where the browser allows it, and starts muted everywhere else.
Autoplay.optionOffDescription: Viewers will press play to start watching.
Autoplay.optionSoundOnlyDescription: The stream starts on its own, but only when the viewer's browser allows sound to play as well. Otherwise the viewer presses play. It never starts silently. Different browsers handle this differently.
Autoplay.title: Autoplay

PlaybackClients.description: Every client currently playing your video, with the most recent playback health measured for it. Permissions.authGate: Act as a viewer-authentication gate, signing viewers in and controlling their access to the site.
Permissions.chatFilter: Inspect and modify chat messages before they are broadcast, or drop them entirely.
Permissions.chatModerate: Hide chat messages and ban users.
Permissions.chatSend: Post chat messages as the plugin’s own bot identity.
Permissions.eventsEmit: Publish custom events that other plugins can subscribe to.
Permissions.fediverseInbound: Receive verified inbound fediverse activity, including follows, likes, reposts, quotes, mentions, replies, and raw activities.
Permissions.fediversePost: Post a public note to the fediverse from the configured Owncast account.
Permissions.httpServe: Serve HTTP requests at /plugins/<name>/ (static assets and a dynamic handler).
Permissions.httpSse: Push Server-Sent-Events to subscribed browser clients.
Permissions.networkFetch: Make outbound HTTP requests to other services.
Permissions.notificationsSend: Send broadcaster notifications via the configured channels.
Permissions.serverRead: Read Owncast configuration and current server state.
Permissions.storageFs: Read and write files in a private, server-side directory only this plugin can access.
Permissions.storageKv: Read and write a per-plugin key-value store that persists across reloads.
Permissions.storageSql: Read and write a private SQLite database that persists across reloads.
Permissions.storageUpload: Upload files to Owncast’s public files area for browser-accessible URLs.
Permissions.uiModify: Make changes to the Owncast user interface.
Permissions.usersRead: Read the chat user list and per-user details.
Permissions.usersRegister: Create and sign in Owncast users for an external identity (such as an OAuth or social account).
Permissions.videoconfigRead: Read stream and video output configuration (encoders, variants).
Permissions.videoconfigWrite: Modify stream and video output configuration.
